preview_mean_n_fixations.Description: Mean across the participant's preview trials of the number of fixations beginning more than 100 ms after search-display onset, up to and including the fixation that landed on the face.

no_preview_mean_n_fixations.Description: Mean across the participant's no-preview trials of the number of fixations beginning more than 100 ms after search-display onset, up to and including the fixation that landed on the face.
